task_evaluations.name: Medallion Architecture
task_evaluations.description: Tests understanding of medallion architecture implementation
task_evaluations.prompt: Explain medallion architecture and when to use bronze, silver, and gold layers.
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should explain the three layers of medallion architecture, their purposes, transformation expectations, and appropriate use cases.
success_criteria: Defines bronze, silver, and gold layers clearly

task_evaluations.name: Partitioning Strategy
task_evaluations.description: Tests ability to recommend partitioning strategies
task_evaluations.prompt: I have a time-series dataset with billions of events. How should I partition it?
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should recommend partitioning strategies for time-series data, considering query patterns, data volume, and file size optimization.

task_evaluations.name: Schema Evolution
task_evaluations.description: Tests handling of schema changes in production
task_evaluations.prompt: How do I handle schema evolution when adding new columns to my data lake?
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should explain schema evolution patterns, backward compatibility, and safe deployment strategies for schema changes.
